patchNotes: Fixed installed Android apps incorrectly reporting Web mode and disabling voice controls.
Added reviewed Chat phone actions with clear Android results and exact target matching.
Connected cloud voice turns to the selected Chat conversation; temporary mode excludes saved history and Memory.
Added read-only web search with source links when supported by the configured provider.
Saved device-reported action outcomes and made completed or cancelled turn retries non-executable.
Fixed Settings navigation, reduced empty Chat space, and retained failed request drafts.
Hardened session changes and late callbacks so old replies cannot restore an abandoned conversation.
Failed result uploads can remain unconfirmed; offline voice commands are outside cloud history.
